purpose: Coordinates of the published public reference assets that the CI reference-asset leg may treat as ground truth. The leg may emit a not_run receipt only when the observed path, sha256, byte length and installed public Core version all match one entry here; any other observation is a hard failure with no receipt at all. Adding or republishing a reference asset is a change to this file and to nothing else on the leg.
registry_scope: Public reference assets of the declared public dependency graph only. No private material, no local machine paths, no work-item identifiers, no build output.
